  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have blood tests at"

  role object "a lab"
  role location "Filiași"
  role time "12"

  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "the doctor"
  role object "the user's doctor"

@a2 assumed
  relation "say something"
  role subject "the user's doctor"
  role object "the blood tests"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a3 assumed
  relation "remember well"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "what the doctor said"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@a4 assumed
  relation "be available"
  role subject "the user's brother-in-law"
  role instrument "a car"
  role destination "from Filiași to Craiova"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "need to do"
    role subject "the blood tests"
    role time "before the consultation"
    polarity affirmed
  end
